findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0364: Exported And Unprotected Activities That Expose Sensitive Functionality
findings.explanation:
Exported activities without a permission. Ward lists them; check whether each one exposes sensitive functionality or trusts its intent's data.
app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:28: activity .help.HelpActivity; exported: yes (android:exported is set); deep link schemes: pennyjar

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0392: References to Enforced Updating APIs
findings.explanation:
No Play In-App Updates API and no backend minimum-version check: startup goes straight from session restore to the app's screens.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/MainActivity.kt:62: Startup flow has no update-enforcement check.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0272: Identify Dependencies with Known Vulnerabilities in the Android Project
findings.explanation:
10 of the declared dependencies with exact versions match no OSV advisory, but 2 declarations have no version Ward can read (see evidence). Check those, and transitive dependencies, with a Gradle-aware scanner. OSV Maven data downloaded 2026-11-25T19:34:24.991Z (published Mon, 23 Nov 2026 21:33:52 GMT).
app/build.gradle.kts:44: androidx.compose.ui:ui: no version (a BOM or constraint may set it)
app/build.gradle.kts:45: androidx.compose.material3:material3: no version (a BOM or constraint may set it)

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0338: References to Storage Integrity Check APIs
findings.explanation:
Whether the biometric lock screen is shown depends only on a plain SharedPreferences boolean (settings.xml) with no HMAC or signature, and settings.xml is not excluded from backup, so flipping it skips the lock.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/settings/SettingsStore.kt:10: Biometric-lock flag read from SharedPreferences without integrity check.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/MainActivity.kt:66: The unverified flag decides whether the app locks.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0295: GMS Security Provider Not Updated
findings.explanation:
The app never calls ProviderInstaller.installIfNeeded(Async) before making network connections; the OkHttp clients are built at application start without updating the security provider.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/PennyJarApp.kt:52: Network clients are created at startup without a prior security provider update.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0242: Missing Certificate Pinning in Network Security Configuration
findings.explanation:
No pin-set in a network security config. Pinning may be done in code (OkHttp CertificatePinner, a custom TrustManager), which Ward doesn't read. MASVS L2 expects pinning; L1 doesn't.
app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:15: networkSecurityConfig @xml/network_security_config

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0258: References to Keyboard Caching Attributes in UI Elements
findings.explanation:
The 'Private note' field, whose content the app treats as sensitive (it encrypts it with a Keystore key before storage), is a plain OutlinedTextField with no non-caching keyboard options, so the keyboard may learn it. The password uses OutlinedSecureTextField.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/ui/AddExpenseScreen.kt:116: Private note field uses default (caching) keyboard options.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0291: References to Screen Capturing Prevention APIs
findings.explanation:
No FLAG_SECURE or other screen-capture prevention anywhere; the app shows financial data and decrypted private notes on the expense list.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/MainActivity.kt:43: Content is set without window FLAG_SECURE.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/ui/ExpenseListScreen.kt:131: Decrypted private note shown on an unprotected screen.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0340: References to Overlay Attack Protections
findings.explanation:
No filterTouchesWhenObscured, onFilterTouchEventForSecurity, obscured-flag checks or setHideOverlayWindows anywhere, while the app has a login screen and a delete-account confirmation; targetSdk is 36.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/auth/LoginScreen.kt:66: Password entry has no overlay/tapjacking protection.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0254: Dangerous App Permissions
findings.explanation:
Dangerous (runtime) permissions requested. Check that each is needed for a feature, and that a weaker one (coarse instead of fine location, foreground instead of background) would not do.
app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:6: android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0318: References to SDK APIs Known to Handle Sensitive User Data
findings.explanation:
The app sends user data to the Mixpanel SDK: identify() with the account's user ID and an expense_added event with spending category, amount band and whether a photo/place was attached (financial info). Tracking is opted out until the user consents, but this still needs to be declared.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/analytics/Analytics.kt:14: User ID shared with Mixpanel.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/analytics/Analytics.kt:24: Expense category and amount band shared with Mixpanel.

findings.title: MASWE-0072: Inadequate Privacy Policy
findings.explanation:
A privacy policy link or text is in the app. Ward doesn't read the policy: check that it matches what the app collects and the Data safety answers.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/settings/SettingsScreen.kt:42: privacy policy
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/settings/SettingsScreen.kt:91: privacy policy
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/settings/SettingsScreen.kt:93: privacy policy

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0324: References to Root Detection Mechanisms
findings.explanation:
No root detection: no su/Magisk/test-keys checks, no root-detection library and no Play Integrity in code or dependencies.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/PennyJarApp.kt:42: App startup performs no root check.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0352: References to Debugging Detection APIs
findings.explanation:
No debugger detection: no Debug.isDebuggerConnected, TracerPid or ptrace checks in code, and no native code.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/PennyJarApp.kt:42: App startup performs no debugger check.
